content.legal-basis-description: Data processing takes place on various legal bases, depending on the type and purpose of the processing:

legal-basis-items.consent: Consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR): If you have given your consent to the data processing.
legal-basis-items.contract: Fulfillment of contract (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR): If the data is required for the fulfillment of a contract or for pre-contractual measures.
legal-basis-items.legal-obligation: Legal obligations (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. c GDPR): If I am legally obligated to process your data.
legal-basis-items.legitimate-interest: Legitimate interest (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR): If the processing is necessary to protect my legitimate interests or those of a third party.

Data transfers to the USA only take place if the recipient is certified under the “EU-US Data Privacy Framework” (DPF) or has additional guarantees.

rights-items.withdrawal: Revocation of your consent: You can revoke a given consent at any time. The legality of the processing carried out until the revocation remains unaffected.

questions.question: 1. What does it cost to create a website or a web application?

answer.description: The costs for creating a website or web application depend on various factors that determine the scope and complexity of the project. These include:

factors.title: Functionality and Scope:
factors.description: A simple website with a few static pages is significantly cheaper than a complex web application with dynamic content, user management, payment integration, or other special functions.

factors.title: Design and User Experience (UX):
factors.description: A custom design tailored to the specific needs and brand requirements of the client requires more time and resources than using pre-made templates.

factors.title: Content Management System (CMS):
factors.description: The choice of a CMS (e.g., WordPress, Joomla) or the development of a custom solution can also influence the costs.

factors.title: Integration of Third-Party Services:
factors.description: Connecting to external APIs or services, such as payment providers, CRM systems, or social media platforms, can cause additional development time and costs.

factors.title: SEO and Performance Optimization:
factors.description: If search engine optimization and performance optimization play a role, this increases the effort, as these measures require specialized knowledge and continuous monitoring.

factors.title: Maintenance and Support:
factors.description: After development, ongoing maintenance, updates, and support should also be taken into account, which should also be budgeted for.

answer.conclusion: Therefore, the price cannot be determined as a flat rate. I work closely with my clients to understand their specific requirements and create an individual offer on this basis. This ensures that the project stays within budget while achieving the desired goals.

questions.question: 2. How does your typical development process work?

answer.description: My development process includes seven steps:
steps: Requirements Analysis: Together we determine your goals and requirements to find the right solution.
Concept & Planning: Based on the requirements, I create a detailed concept and a timeline.
Design: A custom, user-friendly design is developed and optimized based on your feedback.
Development: The website or web application is programmed, and all functions are integrated.
Testing: Comprehensive tests ensure that everything works smoothly.
Launch: The application is launched and I support you with the go-live.
Maintenance & Support: Even after the launch, I am available for updates, support, and optimizations.
answer.conclusion: This process ensures efficient implementation and the highest quality.

questions.question: 3. How is communication handled during a project?

answer.description: During a project, clear and regular communication is crucial for success. This is how I proceed:
steps: Initial Briefing: At the start of the project, a detailed briefing is carried out to clarify all requirements and expectations.

Regular Updates: During the development phase, you receive regular status updates, either via email, phone, or in online meetings. This keeps you up to date and allows you to give feedback at any time.

Feedback Loops: After each important milestone, feedback is collected and integrated into the further development process. This feedback is important to ensure that the project is going in the right direction.

Flexible Communication: I am flexibly available throughout the project and am always ready for questions or adjustments. Communication can take place via various channels such as email, phone, or collaboration tools (e.g., Slack, Teams), depending on your preference.
Final Meeting: After the project is completed, a meeting is held to review the final result and discuss any last-minute adjustments.
Aftercare: Even after the project is completed, I am available for further questions or support requests and am at your side if needed.
answer.conclusion: This structured communication process ensures that you are always informed and the project is successfully completed.

questions.question: 4. What does aftercare look like after project completion?
questions.answer: I am also available for technical support and maintenance work after the project is completed. The exact scope of these services should be defined in advance. This includes fixing bugs, installing updates, and ensuring that everything works smoothly.

questions.question: 5. Do you also offer your service to English-speaking clients?
questions.answer: Yes, my C2-level language skills enable me to work with English-speaking clients for a project. In addition to communication with the client, the programming is then consistently done in English. Note: The translation of this website into the English language is currently still under development.

questions.question: 1. What is the difference between a website and a web application?

answer.description: The difference between a website and a web application can sometimes be fluid, but in general, it is based on the degree of interactivity and functionality that each offers.

details.title: Website:
details.description: A collection of web pages with mostly static information. It usually serves to provide information, such as company information, news, blogs, or portfolios. The interaction is mostly limited to viewing content and simple navigation between pages.

details.title: Web Application:
details.description: An interactive and dynamic application that runs in a web browser. It enables more complex interactions such as editing documents, online shopping, or managing user accounts. Web applications are usually data-driven and often require user login.

answer.conclusion: Websites are thus primarily designed for displaying content, while web applications provide interactive services and functions.

questions.question: 2. How do you guarantee the security and confidentiality of data in the application you develop?

answer.description: The security and confidentiality of data have the highest priority in my projects. Here are the measures I take to ensure this:
measures: Data Protection Compliant Development: From the beginning, care is taken to ensure that the application complies with the applicable data protection laws, such as the GDPR. This includes the implementation of mechanisms for consent declarations and the minimization of data collection.
Encryption: All sensitive data is encrypted both during transmission and during storage. Proven encryption techniques such as SSL/TLS for data transmission and AES for data storage are used.

Access Controls: Strict access controls are implemented to ensure that only authorized users can access certain data. This includes role-based access controls (RBAC) and secure authentication procedures, such as two-factor authentication (2FA).

Security Updates and Monitoring: I ensure that the application is always up to date by regularly installing security updates. In addition, the application is continuously monitored to detect and remedy possible security threats at an early stage.

Confidentiality: All data processed within the scope of the project is treated with strict confidentiality. This applies both during the development phase and beyond. Furthermore, data is only stored on servers that meet the highest security standards.
answer.conclusion: Through these comprehensive security measures, I ensure that your data in the application is always protected and treated confidentially.

questions.question: 3. What role does artificial intelligence (AI) play in your work?

answer.description: Well-known AI applications like ChatGPT are playing an increasingly important role in software development. They help to automate processes and solve problems using data analysis and pattern recognition.
details: I can also make my work more efficient by using AI. This in turn benefits my clients, as I charge fewer working hours due to the reduced workload.

Of course, the 'input' from AI-based systems must be meticulously checked by me as a developer before it is included in the codebase. However, even before the advent of AI, it was necessary for developers to carefully check the code they adopted, as code fragments from online sources – for example, 'stackoverflow.com' – were often used.

arbeitsweise.heading: Efficient Software Development
arbeitsweise.description: In software projects, it is extremely important to achieve the optimal balance between high code quality and efficient development time. These aspects must be coordinated as carefully as possible between developers and project partners. This allows for the programming of long-lasting solutions that meet both current requirements and future developments.

vorteile.heading: The most important advantages of high-quality code for an application:

details.title: Reliability and Stability
details.description: A stable application is less susceptible to errors and crashes. This helps to avoid downtime and achieve a more consistent user experience.

details.title: Cost Savings
details.description: Well-structured code is easier to maintain and expand. Appropriate documentation is also helpful for this. Both reduce long-term maintenance costs, as changes or additions can be implemented more quickly and with less risk.

details.title: Improved User Experience
details.description: The performance and thus speed with which the app responds to user input are improved by clean and well-structured code. The user benefits from shorter loading times.

details.title: Faster Time-to-Market
details.description: With well-structured and documented code, new features and adjustments can be developed and delivered faster. This allows the client to react more quickly to market demands and secure competitive advantages.

details.title: Security
details.description: Appropriate protective measures during programming close security gaps. For the owner of the application, this means better protection against cyber attacks and increased data security.

details.title: Long-term Project Success
details.description: The sustainability of an application largely depends on its programming. Modular and understandable code facilitates future adjustments and expansions.
